list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three La centers are linked by three bridging chloride ligands and coordinated to a pyrene trianion in a μ-η2:η6:η6 mode; two La atoms bind opposite pyrene rings η6, while the third binds a middle ring η2 and is additionally coordinated by THF.

synthesis.procedure: Reaction of the Cp*La chloride lithium adduct with pyrene and potassium in toluene under exclusion of air and moisture produced a red-violet solution, from which red-violet crystals of compound 2·THF were isolated. The article gives no numerical reagent amounts or equivalents for this preparation.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallized from the red-violet reaction solution; specific crystallization conditions are not stated.

title: Synthesis and Properties of Lanthanum–Pyrene Complexes—Structure of [(Cp*La)3(μ-Cl)3(THF)(μ-η2:η6:η6-C16H10)], the First Complex with a Pyrene Trianion
